app.name: WiiFLIX
app.coder: WiiFlix contributors (fork of WiiFin by fabienmillet)
app.short_description: Jellyfin client for your movies and TV shows
app.long_description: WiiFLIX plays the movies and TV shows of your Jellyfin server on the Nintendo Wii, browsed the way the old Wii video channels did: one line of cover art per row (Continue Watching, your Instant Queue, then every genre), a details page for each title, and a player with a scrub bar. A fork of WiiFin, the open-source Jellyfin client for the Wii. GPL-3.0.
